questions.question: The apostle Peter told believers to keep living by the passions they had in their former ignorance. True or false?
Why did the apostle Peter tell believers to be holy in all they do?

answers.text: Because the One who called them is holy
Because their neighbors are watching them closely
Because being holy keeps their troubles away
